changes_zh: 更新检查优先使用静态清单，保留 API 兼容回退；新增框架依赖包，并保留旧版更新器所需的自包含包命名与校验文件。
更新就绪入口持续可见，托盘通知与中继协助申请排队显示；连接操作期间延后更新弹窗，安装时机由用户选择。
连接后收起配置区域，补充 IPv6 状态信息，保留完整构建版本显示，并清理重复节点条目。
自动网络适配可在设置中关闭；诊断上传默认关闭，授权绑定接收节点、地址与证书。
修正托盘退出流程；精简发布包并保留对应源码、许可证与第三方声明。CI 生成自包含和框架依赖两个 Windows x64 包。
changes_en: Try a static update manifest before the API fallback. Add a framework-dependent package while preserving the self-contained filename and checksums needed by the legacy updater.
Keep the update-ready action visible and queue tray notifications and relay-assistance requests. Defer update dialogs during connection operations and let the user choose when to install.
Collapse connection settings while connected, show IPv6 status, retain the full build version and remove duplicate node entries.
Allow automatic network adaptation to be disabled in Settings. Keep diagnostic upload off by default, with authorization bound to the receiving node, address and certificate.
Fix tray exit handling and reduce package size while retaining corresponding source, licenses and third-party notices. CI produces self-contained and framework-dependent Windows x64 packages.
version_note_zh: 已有 0.5.8-10 客户端仍使用 API，也不会把同版本 0.5.8-10 视为升级；静态清单不能改变旧二进制的这一行为。
version_note_en: Existing 0.5.8-10 clients still use the API and will not treat the same 0.5.8-10 version as an upgrade; a static manifest cannot change that old binary's behavior.
